verdict.rationale: Stark Bank's own get-started docs mention a guide for handling its webhook events, so the product does emit webhook callbacks. That is only a single thin mention, though, and registering endpoints and choosing event subscriptions are not shown in the pack. missing for 10: documented webhook endpoint registration/subscription API, list of subscribable event types, delivery/retry and signature-verification details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
